integrity: The proof and code are reproducible. No independence of review or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem compares consecutive integer square arguments for n >= 3 only. It neither implies Legendre's conjecture nor addresses all other monotonicity statements. Finite cases 3..99 use an exhaustive integer certificate, and n >= 100 uses an unconditional published lower bound on pi(x). An unindexed equivalent prior proof remains an originality risk.
title: The decreasing prime-counting roots at consecutive squares
